blocks.title: Digitalization and web presence
items: Design and development of corporate websites

blocks.title: Custom software
blocks.target: For businesses with specific processes that don't fit generic solutions.
items: Bespoke applications and platforms (web/desktop)
Internal management systems (CRM, lightweight ERP, client portals)
Integrations between existing tools (APIs, workflow automation)

blocks.title: Platforms and digital products
blocks.target: For projects born as their own product or SaaS that need solid architecture from the start.
items: Design and development of scalable platforms
Product architecture and MVP definition
Full-stack development oriented to growth and maintainability

blocks.title: Agentic AI and automation
blocks.target: For businesses that want software to make decisions and execute tasks.
items: AI agents for customer service and lead qualification
Automation of administrative and operational processes
Integration of AI into existing products and platforms

blocks.title: Solutions for regulated sectors
blocks.target: For projects where the software must coexist with complex regulation.
items: Portals and tools for interaction with public administrations
Digitalization of processes with legal and fiscal requirements
Experience in the Spanish freelancer and SME ecosystem

blocks.title: Integration with suppliers and clients
blocks.target: For businesses whose operation depends on coordinating with third parties, not just having an isolated system.
items: Connection of in-house systems with supplier platforms (orders, stock, real-time prices)
Client portals: order tracking, billing, centralized communication
Automation of data exchange between companies (APIs, EDI, webhooks) to eliminate manual processes by email or Excel

blocks.title: Catalog digitalization
blocks.target: For businesses whose product — physical or service-based — is not digitally represented in a structured way.
items: Structuring of product catalogs (datasheets, categories, attributes, prices) ready for web, e-commerce or marketplaces
Digitalization from unstructured sources (Excel, PDF, paper, photos) into clean and queryable databases
Integration of the catalog with internal search engines, filters and recommendation AI

blocks.title: AI for sales growth
blocks.target: For businesses that want technology not just to inform, but to sell.
items: AI agents for lead qualification and follow-up
Product recommendation and personalization based on customer behavior
Conversion chatbots oriented to closing sales or scheduling appointments
Predictive analytics: which products and customers are most likely to buy

blocks.title: Intelligence from legacy data
blocks.target: For companies that have been accumulating data for years without knowing what they really have.
blocks.intro: Every company that has been operating for more than a few years has a secret: an old ERP, a database nobody dares to touch, spreadsheets handed down from person to person, systems that no longer even the person who programmed them understands. There is no garbage in there. There is history. There are purchasing patterns that nobody has looked at in years, customers who stopped buying without anyone asking why, margins that vary for reasons that today nobody could explain.
blocks.intro2: The problem has never been the lack of data, but the lack of time, tools and criteria to turn it into useful information. Today, artificial intelligence can enter that chaos — structured or not, in whatever database — clean it, organize it, and find what the company didn't even know it had stored in a drawer.
items: Audit and cleaning of data in legacy systems, whatever the database or source format
Structuring of dispersed or unstructured information (loose tables, documents, spreadsheets, undocumented systems)
Extraction of insights with AI: hidden patterns, business opportunities, undetected risks
Executive reports that translate technical findings into actionable business decisions

methodPage.metaDescription: Nortex's proprietary method: a disciplined cycle of continuous improvement — Discover, Define, Design, Deliver, Demonstrate.

intro.title: The Nortex 5D Method
intro.lead: At Nortex, every digital transformation is guided by our structured 5D method. Each phase is an opportunity to align objectives, maximize results and ensure that engineering drives the transformation.
intro.cycleNote: Continuous improvement cycle: Discover → Define → Design → Deliver → Demonstrate → (back to Discover)

detail.name: Discover
detail.body: Every successful software project starts by understanding the business ecosystem. We assess existing systems, operational processes, technical constraints, stakeholders and strategic objectives to establish a clear engineering baseline.

detail.name: Define
detail.tagline: Translate business needs into engineering requirements
detail.body: Ideas become specifications. Requirements are documented, prioritized, validated and transformed into a roadmap that aligns business objectives with technical feasibility.

detail.name: Design
detail.body: Instead of jumping straight into development, we design systems intentionally. Architecture, integrations, security and AI flows are defined before implementation.

detail.name: Deliver
detail.body: Implementation follows the established specifications, applying modern engineering practices, continuous validation and transparent communication. Software is built to remain maintainable long after deployment.

detail.name: Demonstrate
detail.body: Once the software is in production, measurement becomes the next phase of engineering. Performance, adoption, automation opportunities and new business needs feed the next iteration of improvement.

closing.title: Why this framework matters
closing.body: Many firms focus on delivering software. Nortex focuses on building systems. Our methodology ensures that every project follows a disciplined progression — from understanding the business context to designing resilient architectures, implementing with precision and continuously improving based on measurable results. The result is software that not only works on day one, but is adaptable, maintainable and aligned with long-term business objectives.
